description: Two upgrades in one: a permanent public console link via Tailscale Funnel (install step 6/6 shows and opens the registration link, then prints the public URL), and the embedding model now downloads automatically on first run with a check-first delta sync — no prompt and no manual copy needed.
features: Install step 6/6: Tailscale check, registration link shown and opened, Funnel enabled, permanent public URL printed.
New command: python -m web.server.server --public for the public link on any machine.
New /api/public_share endpoint with read-only share status for the dashboard.
First run fetches the embedding model automatically (~1.2GB once, resume on restart).
Smart check first: complete setups run instantly with zero network; updates sync only changed files.
Removed the manual download prompt and the release-zip copy steps.
Works on Windows and Linux with stdlib only; the local console works even when sharing is skipped.
